title: Raw database driver failures escape local admission cleanup
description: Raw asyncpg connection, timeout and authentication failures bypassed the SQLAlchemy-only handler, entering bridge send-failure cleanup.
suggestion: Normalize non-cancellation exceptions at the narrow model-evidence lookup boundary.
impact: Unsent request could interrupt accepted siblings, expose driver details and penalize account health.

title: Model exclusion prevents guarded goal-restart owner replacement
description: Cached and in-flight owner checks rejected classified restarts before the existing guarded selector could evaluate replacement.
suggestion: Pass the existing restart capability into the shared owner predicate, preserving selector ownership/status checks.
impact: A valid self-contained goal restart remains pinned to an unavailable excluded legacy owner.

title: Cold selection and direct WebSocket miss failure isolation
description: Independent review reproduced lookup failures escaping cold selection and direct WebSocket admission; its final P1 additionally caught dictionary payload attribute access in the first draft of the catch.
suggestion: Share the admission boundary with the balancer and direct WebSocket, read the error envelope as a mapping and reject only the unsent turn.
impact: Cold HTTP returns an uncontrolled error; a reused WebSocket can disconnect accepted sibling work and penalize health.

title: Rotation conflict discards confirmed downgrade evidence
description: Independent review P2 reproduced the second Free observation being cleared before a token-guarded metadata write; a rotation conflict then exhausted remaining attempts without confirming Free.
suggestion: Keep agreeing observations until metadata sync succeeds and clear them with the current generation afterward.
impact: API can report Plus and no pending check even after agreeing Free samples.

title: Cold WebSocket selection bypasses local admission rejection
description: Review 2 reproduced normalized evidence lookup errors escaping the initial real WebSocket selector on both routes.
suggestion: Emit the structured connect error and propagate the existing handled sentinel, settling the unsent turn and allowing a later turn on the same socket.
impact: Cold sockets emit stream_incomplete, propagate an exception and cannot retry on the existing connection.

title: Ordinary confirmation clears replacement credential evidence
description: Review 2 reproduced generation-less evidence consumption deleting a replacement credential’s new first Free observation after the older refresh persisted Free.
suggestion: Fence updater evidence clears with persisted credential generation and installation identity after locking the account row, alongside any priority generation guard.
impact: The final retry can restart confirmation at one and leave a stale Plus plan with no pending check.

title: Paid reset loses evidence clearing during routine rotation
description: Final independent review reproduced an exact-token guard retaining Free evidence contradicted by a paid sample, so the next single Free sample could downgrade incorrectly.
suggestion: Fence by persisted credential replacement generation and account installation identity, which survive routine rotation.
impact: False Free confirmation after an intervening paid sample.

title: First-Free enqueue is suppressed by routine rotation
description: Final independent review reproduced token rotation between observing Free and enqueue suppressing all priority verification.
suggestion: Use persisted replacement generation and installation identity for source/current checks; replacement increments generation atomically even with unchanged token values.
impact: Stale Plus without a pending priority check until the ordinary fleet scan.
